metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills, MCP servers and hooks.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security hardening and review skills for web apps and servers: nginx SPA security headers / CSP, and an outside-in production deployment audit.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development workflow tools: mental-model architecture docs, step-by-step plans with review stops, versioned agent-instruction snippets for CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, and a Plain English (ELI5 + ASD-STE-100) output style.

plugins.name: aws
plugins.description: Set up and check AWS services for small web apps: SES transactional email (DKIM, MAIL FROM, DMARC, sandbox, least-privilege IAM, mailer, checks) and private S3 buckets (setup, read-back checks, presigned uploads/downloads, least-privilege IAM).

plugins.name: web-development
plugins.description: Conventions and tools for full-stack TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepos (Express 5 + Kysely + Postgres, Vite/Next frontends) deployed to a VPS with PM2 + nginx: monorepo scaffolding, API conventions, env var sync check, release pipeline, Markdown for agents (Accept: text/markdown negotiation), and an opt-in guard hook that blocks migrations and git commit/push.
